entry.header: Control plane · every action is recorded

key.title: Use your security key
key.body: Insert or tap one of your registered keys. Phone passkeys aren’t accepted here.

failed.title: That key didn’t work
failed.body: Nothing changed. Try again, or use your other key.

entry.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

enroll.title: Register two security keys
enroll.body: You need two keys: one to use, one as a backup. You can’t open the Control Plane until both are registered.

enrollSecond.title: Now your backup key
enrollSecond.body: Use a different physical key. Keep it somewhere safe.

entry.duplicate: That key is already registered. Use a different physical key.
entry.rejected: That key can’t be used here. Use a hardware security key, not a phone or a synced passkey.

enrollDone.title: Your keys are registered
enrollDone.body: You can now open the Control Plane. What you can see depends on the permissions an operator manager gave you.

reverify.title: Confirm it’s you again
reverify.body: Your security check has expired. Use your key to continue where you were.

recovery.title: Lost your keys?
recovery.body: There’s no self-service recovery. Another operator manager can revoke your old keys and let you register new ones. If you’re the last one, recovery is a reviewed procedure with SimpleFit’s maintainers.

enrollmentExpired.title: Your setup window has ended
enrollmentExpired.body: Your security keys weren’t registered in time. Ask an operator manager to set up your access again.

unsupported.title: This browser can’t use security keys
unsupported.body: Open SimpleFit in a current browser that supports hardware security keys.

serviceUnavailable.title: Security keys aren’t available right now

unavailable.title: We can’t find that page
unavailable.body: This page doesn’t exist, or it isn’t available to your account.

workspace.keyChecked: Key checked · {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} left
workspace.permissions: {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}} · each granted separately
workspace.exitFailed: We couldn’t end the key check. Try again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.heading: Welcome to the Control Plane
welcome.body: This is where SimpleFit is run. You see only what you’ve been granted.

access.title: Your access
access.notYet: Overview, users, gyms, gym verification and system health aren’t part of the Control Plane yet.

welcome.note: A tour or checklist never adds access. Only an operator manager can, and that’s recorded.
welcome.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

steps.check: Check what the action does and to whom.
steps.result: The result, or an honest “we don’t know yet”, and an audit entry.

tour.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

finishing.title: Finishing…
finishing.body: Saving that you finished the tour.

finishFailed.title: We couldn’t finish the tour
finishFailed.body: Nothing was saved. Try again, or skip the tour.

confirm.label: Skip the tour
confirm.title: Skip the tour?
confirm.body: You won’t see it again. Everything it shows stays on this page.

welcome.title: What this is
welcome.body: The Control Plane runs SimpleFit. This card lists exactly what you can open.

sensitive.title: Sensitive actions
sensitive.body: Reason, key check, confirmation, then a result you can trust.

me.title: Your key check and leaving
me.body: Your key check and permissions are shown here. “Exit control plane” ends your key check.

done.title: You’re ready
done.body: You won’t see this again. Everything it showed stays in the menu.

overview.title: Overview

population.title: Population
population.asOf: As of {time} · a count, not a trend

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.caption: registered · {notFinished, plural, one {# not finished} other {# not finished}}

gyms.label: Gyms
gyms.caption: completed · {drafts, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
gyms.period: {count, plural, one {# completed setup} other {# completed setup}} {range}

sponsor_organizations.label: Sponsor orgs
sponsor_organizations.caption: active · {suspended, plural, one {# suspended} other {# suspended}}

population.restrictedHint: Needs a permission you don’t have

reviews.title: Waiting for review

gymVerifications.label: Gym verifications
gymVerifications.unavailable: Not available yet: there’s no operator review for gyms.

reviews.moderation: Moderation isn’t available: there’s no reports domain yet.

health.title: System health
health.note: Unknown is never shown as healthy. Nothing here is an uptime figure.

degraded.title: Some background jobs failed in the last 24 hours.

overview.restricted: Other sections need permissions you don’t have.

forbidden.title: The overview needs permissions you don’t have
forbidden.body: An operator manager can grant them. Nothing here is hidden as zero.

search.label: Exact email or user ID
search.note: Search is exact by design: there’s no list of everyone. Each search is recorded with its reason.
search.idle: Enter an exact email or user ID, and a reason.

noMatch.title: No account matches
noMatch.body: Check the address or ID. Search doesn’t do partial matches.

search.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a while, then try again.

restricted.title: You don’t have access to this section
restricted.body: Your operator permissions don’t include it. An operator manager can grant it, with a reason that’s recorded.

detail.title: Account
detail.reasonTitle: Why are you opening this account?
detail.reasonBody: Every view is recorded with its reason.

notFound.title: No such account
notFound.body: Check the ID, or search again.

contexts.title: Contexts
contexts.never: Never shown here: passwords, codes, tokens, provider data, training sessions, coach notes, weight, health and messages.

security.title: Account and security
security.verification: A sign-in method means the person proved control of it. No identity or document check exists.

detail.recovery: There’s no account recovery to run here: sign-in is passwordless. Operators can’t change sign-in methods, verify anything or act as the person.

actions.smallScreen: High-risk actions need a larger screen and a security key. Reading works here.
actions.operatorTarget: This account is a platform operator: it’s managed in operator administration.

reveal.title: Reveal this email address?
reveal.body: Needs users.reveal_email and a fresh key check. Recorded with your reason.
reveal.failed: We couldn’t reveal it. Nothing was shown.

impacts.signed_out_everywhere: They’re signed out on every device now.
impacts.sign_in_refused: They can’t sign in with any method until the suspension is lifted.
impacts.memberships_unchanged: Gym and Sponsor memberships aren’t changed.
impacts.sessions_stay_revoked: Sessions ended by the suspension stay ended.

action.stepUp: Confirm with your security key. High-risk actions need a key check in the last few minutes.
action.success: Done. Recorded in the audit log.
action.conflict: Someone else changed this first. Nothing was changed. Reload to see the current state.
action.unknown: We don’t know if this went through. Don’t retry yet. Reload the account to check.
action.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing changed. Try again.
action.denied: You no longer have permission for this. Nothing changed.

protected.self: You can’t do this to your own account.
protected.operator: This account is a platform operator: use operator administration.

profiles.note: Exact lookup only, with a reason that’s recorded. Profiles show what the person shares, plus counts. Training, notes, weight, health and messages are never shown here.
profiles.activeRelationships: {count, plural, one {# active relationship} other {# active relationships}}
profiles.name: Display name
profiles.accountNote: The account and the profile are separate: a suspended account keeps its profile and relationships.
profiles.relationshipsNote: Counts only. Who the other person is and what they share stays between them.

fighter.label: @username, exact email or user ID
fighter.idle: Enter a fighter’s @username, or their exact email or user ID, and a reason.
fighter.never: Weight, height, goals, fights, age and health aren’t shown: no permission exists for them.

coach.label: Exact email or user ID
coach.idle: Enter a coach’s exact email or user ID, and a reason.
coach.gymsNote: Gyms where they’re staff as a coach. Opening a gym needs gym access.
coach.never: The bio, schedule, prices, sessions and notes aren’t shown. Coaches have no verification.

gyms.title: Gyms
gyms.note: Gyms only: their state, location and staff count. Member names and contact details aren’t part of this list. Each query is recorded.
gyms.publicationNote: Gym publication isn’t available yet (SF-139 is a proposal), so no gym is public.

detail.title: Gym
detail.reasonTitle: Why are you opening this gym?
detail.reasonBody: Opening a gym is recorded with your reason.
detail.noActions: Read only. Suspending a gym, reviewing its verification and publishing it aren’t part of the Control Plane.

notFound.title: No such gym
notFound.body: Check the link. The gym may never have existed.

people.title: People
people.never: Member names and contact details aren’t shown here.

verification.title: Business verification
verification.reviewNote: The status of the gym’s application. Its business details and documents aren’t shown, and reviewing isn’t part of the Control Plane yet.

profile.title: Gym
profile.publication: Public page: not available. Gym publication is a proposal (SF-139); nothing is public.

queue.caption: Sponsor applications, oldest submission first

empty.title: No applications match
empty.body: New submissions appear here. Try other filters.

queue.note: Drafts aren’t listed: nobody at SimpleFit sees them. Each query is recorded.

bodies.claim: Starts the review. Anyone with the review permissions can then decide.
bodies.request_changes: The applicant sees your message, can edit the answers you choose and resubmits.
bodies.approve: Creates the organization and makes the applicant its owner. No contract, verification, payment, campaign or listing. Needs a key check.
bodies.reject: Final. Nothing is created. The reason is internal: the applicant isn’t shown it. Needs a key check.
bodies.suspend_organization: The organization becomes read only for its members and stops being a workspace. Nothing is deleted. Needs a key check.
bodies.reinstate_organization: The organization becomes usable again. Needs a key check.

impacts.applicant_can_edit_requested_answers: The applicant can edit the answers you chose
impacts.applicant_notified: The applicant is told (email only where enabled)
impacts.no_commercial_rights: No contract, payment, campaign or placement

action.messageHelp: Plain text, up to 2,000 characters. The applicant sees it.
action.stepUp: Check your security key to continue.
action.success: Done. Recorded in the audit log.

outcomes.conflict: Someone else changed this application first, or its state no longer allows this. Nothing was done.
outcomes.expired: The confirmation expired or was already used. Preview again.
outcomes.unknown: We don’t know whether this went through. Check the outcome: the same request is sent again and never applies twice.
outcomes.invalid: Check the reason, the answers and the message.
outcomes.denied: You’re no longer allowed to do this.
outcomes.party: You’re a party to this application. Another operator must decide.

notFound.title: No such application
notFound.body: Check the link. Drafts aren’t visible to operators.

answers.title: Submitted answers
answers.note: These are the applicant’s own answers. Only the work email is checked, by a code; nothing else is verified.

review.title: Review
review.party: You can’t review this application: you’re a party to it. Another operator must decide.

state.under_review: Under review. Anyone with the decision permissions can decide.
state.changes_requested: Waiting for the applicant to resubmit.

review.smallScreen: High-risk actions need a larger screen and a security key. Reading works here.
review.notPermitted: Some actions aren’t shown: your permissions don’t include them.
review.approvalNote: Approving creates the organization and makes the applicant its owner. It isn’t a contract, a verification or a partnership.

notes.suspended: Read only for its members, and not a workspace. Nothing was deleted.

history.title: History
history.note: Status changes as the backend recorded them. Who acted is shown as applicant or operator only.

documents.title: Documents

errors.step_up: Check your security key, then try again.
errors.failed: Couldn’t get the document. Try again.

documents.note: Each download is a 5-minute link, recorded before it’s issued. Documents are what the applicant uploaded: not checked for authenticity or malware.

trustSafety.notState: This isn’t an empty queue, a missing permission or an error: the feature doesn’t exist yet.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.heading: Moderation isn’t part of the Control Plane yet
moderation.body: There’s nothing to review. SimpleFit has no reports, posts, comments, messages or public media, so no content can be reported, reviewed or hidden. No report is shown here because none exists.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.heading: Enforcement and appeals aren’t part of the Control Plane yet
enforcement.body: No enforcement case, strike or appeal exists. An account suspension can’t be appealed here: how people are told and how they appeal still needs counsel.

accounts.body: Suspending an account or signing it out everywhere (needs account permissions).

sponsors.body: Suspending a sponsor organization. That’s business review, not moderation.

gyms.title: Gym verification
gyms.body: A separate business review, not moderation. It isn’t part of the Control Plane yet.

needs.title: Needed before moderation can be built
needs.intake: What can be reported, and by whom
needs.reasons: Report reasons and what evidence is kept
needs.hiding: What hiding means for each kind of content, and where it’s enforced
needs.notice: How people are told and how they appeal (needs counsel)
needs.permissions: Separate moderation permissions for reading and acting

operations.title: System health
operations.checkedAt: Checked {time} · updates every minute while open
operations.noHealthAccess: System health needs health access. Your permissions include the job list only.
operations.stale: Couldn’t check again. This is the answer from {time}, not the current state.

unreachable.title: We can’t reach the health checks.
unreachable.body: Everything shows as unknown until they answer. Nothing here means a service is down.

legend.label: Statuses
legend.note: Unknown is never shown as healthy. Nothing here is an uptime percentage: none is measured.

services.title: Service health
services.caption: Service health, each check with its source and when it was measured

sources.background_jobs: Oban: {waiting} waiting, {executing} running, {failed} failed in 24 h
sources.email: Delivery jobs in 24 h: {accepted} accepted by the provider, {failed} failed, {pending} pending. Acceptance isn’t delivery.
sources.payments_webhooks: Last webhook {time} · {received} received, {failed} failed in 24 h

queues.title: Queues
queues.caption: Background job counts per queue and state
queues.note: Unfinished jobs, plus finished ones from the last 24 hours: Oban removes them after a day.

release.title: Release
release.applied: {count, plural, one {# applied} other {# applied}} · latest {latest}
release.note: As configured. No deploy, migration or restart can be started here.

source.default: (none set: the app version stands in)

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.noAccess: The job list needs job access.
jobs.caption: Background jobs, newest first
jobs.note: Metadata only: job arguments and error messages are never shown. Failure is the error’s type only. Each query is recorded.

detail.gone: This job no longer exists (finished jobs are removed after a day).
detail.retry: Retry isn’t available: no worker has an approved retry policy.

billing.title: Billing visibility
billing.stale: Couldn’t read again. These figures are from {time}, not current.

unreachable.title: We can’t reach the billing records.
unreachable.body: No figure is shown until they answer. Nothing here means a payment failed.

mode.label: Stripe mode
mode.note: Every figure on this page is from {mode} mode only. Test and live records are never added together.

integration.disabled: Stripe integration off: nothing is being synced, so these figures can’t change.
integration.misconfigured: Stripe integration misconfigured: nothing is being synced.

flows.title: Money flows
flows.note: These are four separate money flows. They’re never added together. Stripe Live is not approved (SF-138).

saas.title: SimpleFit gym subscriptions
saas.body: Gyms paying SimpleFit, through Stripe (SF-102). Read only: status, payment issues and reconciliation.

member.title: Gym member subscriptions
member.body: Members paying their gym. The gym’s money; nothing is collected through SimpleFit.

sponsor.title: Sponsor agreements
sponsor.body: None exist. Commercial terms aren’t approved (D-SA23).

revenue.title: Platform revenue
revenue.body: Not reported. No figure is shown until an approved definition and source exist.

overview.title: Gym subscriptions
overview.caption: Subscriptions by SimpleFit status, in {mode} mode
overview.unrecorded: {count, plural, one {# subscription has no provider record (no Stripe checkout or link). It is in no mode’s figures.} other {# subscriptions have no provider record (no Stripe checkout or link). They are in no mode’s figures.}}
overview.providerCaption: Stripe subscriptions by Stripe’s status, as last read. Stripe’s “active” isn’t a collected payment.
overview.issuesNote: A failed attempt isn’t final: Stripe may try again. Nothing here needs an action from the Control Plane.
overview.collectedNote: Gross amount paid of invoices paid {from} – {to}, per currency. Not revenue: before refunds, disputes, fees and tax. Currencies are never added together.
overview.collectedEmpty: No invoice was paid in this period.
overview.unavailableNote: No approved definition exists, so no figure is shown.

detail.title: Subscription
detail.cancelAtPeriodEnd: Cancels at period end at Stripe
detail.agreedNote: The version and price the gym agreed to. A newer plan version never changes it.
detail.periodsEmpty: No paid period: nothing was verified.
detail.periodsNote: Only from a verified paid invoice.
detail.noActions: No refund, cancellation, retry or price change is available here. Refunds stay a reviewed operation outside the Control Plane.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.caption: How SimpleFit’s records compare with Stripe, in {mode} mode
reconciliation.note: There is no reconciliation run. Each Stripe subscription link records when Stripe was last read and any discrepancy found. Nothing here forces a sync.
reconciliation.webhooksCaption: Stripe events received since {time}, by processing status
reconciliation.backlog: {count, plural, one {# event waiting to be processed.} other {# events waiting to be processed.}}
reconciliation.failedNote: Type and outcome only. Payloads are never stored; nothing is replayed from here.
reconciliation.discrepanciesCaption: Subscriptions whose last Stripe read couldn’t be applied
reconciliation.discrepanciesEmpty: No discrepancy recorded at the last reads. That says nothing about subscriptions that were never read.

invoices.title: Stripe invoices
invoices.caption: Recorded Stripe invoices of gym subscriptions, newest first
invoices.intro: Invoices of gyms paying SimpleFit, as last read from Stripe. Amounts are Stripe’s, each in its own currency.
invoices.noRefunds: Refunds aren’t available here. They stay a reviewed operation outside the Control Plane.

plans.title: Plans
plans.caption: SimpleFit plans and every version as recorded
plans.intro: Read only. Plans are published under an approval outside the Control Plane; nothing here edits a price, a version or an entitlement.

discrepancy.ended_locally_live_at_provider: Ended here, still live at Stripe

configuration.title: Feature switches

unreachable.title: We can’t reach the configuration.
unreachable.body: No switch is shown until it answers. Nothing here means a feature is off.

configuration.intro: Every switch is set by this deployment’s environment. The only change available is suspending one of the allowlisted features: it turns the feature off until restored. Nothing here can turn on what the deployment left off.
configuration.notShown: Secrets, credentials, database and provider settings, URLs and operator settings are never shown or changed here.
configuration.notSupported: No percentage rollout, targeting, guardrail or rollout metric exists: none is measured or approved.
configuration.caption: Registered feature switches with their source, consumer, control, risk and effective value

actions.label: {action} {switch}
actions.noWrite: Suspending or restoring needs configuration write access.

history.title: Change history
history.caption: Every suspension and restore, newest first

dialog.needs: Needs {permission} and a fresh security-key check

impacts.new_member_invitation_emails_stop: No new member invitation is created or resent.
impacts.new_staff_invitation_emails_stop: No new staff invitation is created or resent.
impacts.deployment_decides: The deployment decides again whether the feature is on.
impacts.deployment_disabled_no_effect: The deployment has it off, so this changes nothing until it’s turned on there.
impacts.effective_next_check_every_instance: Every server instance sees it on its next check.
impacts.not_retroactive: Nothing that already happened is undone.

dialog.stepUp: Confirm with your security key to continue.
dialog.success: Done. The change is committed; every instance sees it on its next check.
dialog.conflict: This switch changed since you read it. Close to read its current state, then review the change again.
dialog.unknown: We didn’t get an answer, so the change may or may not have been made. Close to read the current state before trying again.
dialog.invalid: This confirmation expired or no longer matches. Review the change again.
dialog.failed: Couldn’t review the change. Try again.
dialog.denied: You don’t have permission for this change.

operators.title: Operators
operators.intro: Everyone who can open the Control Plane, each permission they hold, and who granted it, when and why. Every change needs a reason and a fresh security-key check, and is recorded.
operators.notSupported: Two-person approval, break-glass access, single sign-on and access requests aren’t available. One operator manager acts alone, never on themselves, and the last manager always stays.
operators.noManage: You can see operators. Changing them needs operators.manage.

unreachable.title: Couldn’t load operators
unreachable.body: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.

restricted.title: You don’t have access to the operator list
restricted.body: It needs operators.read. An operator manager can grant it, with a reason that’s recorded. Your own security is below.

inventory.title: Operators
inventory.caption: Operators, their status, permissions, security keys and last key check

add.title: Add an operator
add.body: An existing SimpleFit account becomes an operator with the permissions you choose.
add.accountHint: Their exact verified email address or user ID. Nothing is searched or suggested.
add.note: They must register their own two security keys before anything works. You can’t add yourself.
add.success: Added. They hold nothing usable until they register their two keys.

problems.not_eligible: No account we can add matches that. Check the exact address or ID. Nothing changed.
problems.exists: That account is already an operator. Nothing changed.
problems.self: You can’t add yourself. Nothing changed.
problems.invalid: Check the account, permissions and reason. Nothing changed.
problems.denied: You no longer have permission for this. Nothing changed.
problems.unknown: We didn’t get an answer, so we don’t know whether they were added. Trying again is safe: it can’t add them twice.
problems.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing changed. Try again.

detail.self: This is you. You can’t change your own permissions or status.
detail.pending: Waiting for their security keys: {registered} of {required} registered.

actions.smallScreen: High-risk actions need a larger screen and a security key. Reading works here.

dialog.needs: Needs {permission} and a fresh security-key check
dialog.stepUp: This needs a fresh security-key check. Use your key, then review again.

success.grant: Granted. It’s recorded with your reason.
success.suspend: Suspended. Their access and key checks ended.

problems.conflict: Someone changed this operator first. Nothing changed. Reload and look again.
problems.self: You can’t do this to yourself. Nothing changed.
problems.invalid: This confirmation is no longer valid. Nothing changed. Reload and review again.
problems.unknown: We didn’t get an answer, so we don’t know whether it worked. Reload to see the current state.
problems.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing changed. Try again.
problems.denied: You no longer have permission for this. Nothing changed.

impacts.permission_granted: The permission is added, recorded with your reason.
impacts.effective_now: It works from their next request.
impacts.access_blocked: They can’t open the Control Plane.
impacts.key_checks_ended: Their current key checks end now.
impacts.access_restored: Their access and permissions work again.
impacts.security_keys_required: They must register security keys again before anything works.
impacts.permissions_revoked: Every permission they hold is removed.
impacts.security_keys_revoked: Every security key they registered is removed.
impacts.irreversible: This can’t be undone. Adding them again starts from nothing.

security.title: Your security
security.keyCheck: Key checked · {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} left
security.rules: You need at least {required} keys. You can’t remove your last ones: add a replacement first.
security.selfRules: You can’t grant yourself anything or change your own status. Another operator manager can.

notes.minimum: That would leave fewer keys than required. Add a replacement first. Nothing changed.
notes.keyFailed: The key wasn’t added. Nothing changed.
notes.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing changed. Try again.
